name: Colossus
author: Erin Carter
description: Two colossal seated figures flank a narrow defile, abstracted to stacked stone primitives and mirrored across the path, with further pairs receding into altitude haze. A raymarched 3D solid scene where the camera cranes vertically — rising from among the knees until the faces emerge from the fog overhead, then settling on a long sinusoidal cycle. A faint rim catches where mass meets brighter fog; an ember glows in the crevice where each figure meets its plinth.

params.label: Crane speed
params.effect: How fast the camera rises and settles along the figures' height.

params.label: Crane range
params.effect: How far the excursion travels — low hovers among the knees, high reaches the faces.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: How heavily altitude haze swallows the upper bodies and the deeper pairs.

params.label: Ember glow
params.effect: Warmth of the residual offering-light at the base of each figure.
